definitions: To move on one's hands and knees or with the body close to the ground.
To be full of or covered with a large number of insects or other small creatures, in a way that is unpleasant.
To feel as if insects are crawling on one's skin.
examples: The baby learned to crawl at six months.
The traffic was crawling along the motorway.
The old meat was crawling with maggots.
My skin crawls when I think about it.
I'm exhausted, I'm going to crawl into bed.
